boundary: Static SDK observations and vendor documentation. No camera execution is established by this ledger. Proprietary artifacts and decompilations are retained privately; summaries do not redistribute them.

findings.observation: The SDK USB control path sends operation 0x9201 with [1,0,0], then [2,0,0], then [3,0,0]. Device information and extended capability negotiation occur between phases 2 and 3.
findings.simulationEffect: Parameter-sensitive ordered prerequisites on reviewed documented model profiles; reads can interleave. Missing prerequisites report missing profile data because the actual camera rejection is unknown.
limitations: Shared SDK path is not proof that every supported Sony model or firmware follows it.
Negotiation payloads, phase replies and failure responses were not captured on these bodies.
The scoped simulator prerequisite does not model full version negotiation.

findings.observation: SDK connection modes check contents-transfer/media-server capability separately; version operation 0x9216 is conditional on advertisement.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. Do not infer media retrieval or network transport support from successful USB remote control.
limitations: No universal per-model feature table recovered.

findings.observation: SDK movie Record API is translated into vendor property 0xd1b8 as UINT32 through operation 0x9110. The data begins with UINT32 total property-block byte length and UINT32 property code, followed by value bytes.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. SDK property IDs and error numbers must not be used as PTP wire IDs.
limitations: Does not establish movie-mode readiness or acceptance on an individual body.

findings.observation: Session initialization selects remote mode according to camera classification and retries. Remote/event modes use 0x9114/0x9115; they are not interchangeable with movie-mode selection.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. Preserve known per-model mode values rather than assigning one handshake to all Canon bodies.
limitations: Classifications were not completely mapped to USB model identities.

findings.observation: Record value 4 starts and 0 stops. Software movie-mode switching has hardware-mode, camera-storage destination and cleanup prerequisites.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only; do not represent movie recording as a standalone universally accepted property write.
limitations: Some models require a physical switch; applicability requires the model feature table or bench evidence.

findings.observation: Canon lists these models for the SDK while excluding remote capture.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. SDK model listing is not a remote-capture guarantee.
limitations: SDK-level exclusion does not establish rejection of every PTP capture opcode.

locations: Command sections 6.2.7.1 and 6.5.12.6; PDF pages 143 and 527
findings.observation: Movie start 0x920a requires live view; nonzero recording-prohibition property 0xd0a4 prevents recording. Application mode, photo/video mode and card state are separate prerequisites.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only until state/readback evidence can anchor a model-specific scenario.
limitations: No new hardware validation; no speculative camera success, recording files or busy durations.

findings.observation: GetEventEx 0x941c uses a UINT32 event count and per-event parameter counts. Parameter 1 retains queued events; zero or omitted drains them.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. Legacy Nikon 0x90c7 event framing must not be substituted for this model path.
limitations: The SDK defines the contract; actual event timing/content remains hardware evidence.

findings.observation: The vendor SDK module has a single-camera limit and warns of competing Nikon applications.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. Keep SDK process constraints separate from Darkgrade PTP or Fleet multi-camera capability.
limitations: Does not establish a one-camera limit for the PTP wire protocol.

findings.observation: No matches in the provider-defined string inventory for this bounded search.
findings.simulationEffect: None. Use the matched model configuration and command documentation; do not infer absence of support from a stripped binary.
limitations: Not a complete byte-string search or proof that functions are absent.

findings.observation: Sony documents model/firmware-specific focus-position value incompatibility after upgrades and warns that some PTP 2 commands may become unusable from 2027. Its 2.00 release corrected incompatible command checkmarks for 25 models.
findings.simulationEffect: Reference only. Keep firmware and command-family provenance; do not extrapolate a supported-device list into a command compatibility guarantee.
limitations: No affected command list or migration behavior has been modeled.

acquisition.result: Existing local Sony 2.02, Canon 13.20.21 and Nikon Z-series 2.1 already cover the current bench families. Official pages were reviewed; no application or license gate was bypassed.
acquisition.next: Acquire additional model SDKs through their official application flow when targeting an uncovered body; compare versioned command references before widening modeled behavior.
